secrets.PREFLIGHT_AUDIT_TOKEN: read Actions secret/variable metadata, environments, workflows, and immutable refs across registered repositories

secrets.CODEX_ROUTER_TOKEN: write the router-owned admission journal and dispatch only registered target workflows
secrets.PORTFOLIO_ISSUE_TOKEN: invalidate approval and project source lifecycle labels

variables.PORTFOLIO_APPROVERS: authorized human logins allowed to apply approval
variables.PORTFOLIO_RESULT_SENDERS: receiver identities allowed to invoke the retained v2 source projector

secrets.CODEX_RESULT_TOKEN: send one canonical result to the organization receiver and write only the source result journal
secrets.CODEX_TARGET_TRUSTED_CALLERS: router identities allowed to invoke the target adapter
secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY: invoke Codex only inside the target execution job
secrets.TARGET_PUBLICATION_TOKEN: create or reuse one delivery-owned branch and draft pull request
